reason: Consolidate complete novelty11 nine-survivor set and source-confirmed Q18 asked-survival key correction, before any expanded readers. Existing each-player noninterleaving, cleanup-before-outcome and Sworn Range1 already explicit. Native-panel audit remains pending; new exact-byte source audit required.

changes.new: **Remove** returns the specified pieces without requiring Damage to reach their Health and without destruction Fear.

changes.old: With one Spirit, use one board and all per-player amounts for one.
changes.new: All eight original-base Spirits, including Ocean and Bringer, are legal in one-Spirit solo and can win solo. With one Spirit, use one board and all per-player amounts for one.

changes.old: Each player takes one color's 13 Presence and reminder markers,
changes.new: Each player takes one color's 13 Presence and reminder markers (any accidental extra disk is a spare, not additional Presence for play),

changes.old: Speed/Range/targeting modifiers are checked in time to use them before targeting,
changes.new: Apply a threshold changing Speed, Range or targeting when checking that attribute, before the ordinary effects: for example, Thunderspeaker's met Fast threshold permits using its Innate in Fast. Speed/Range/targeting modifiers are checked in time to use them before targeting,

changes.old: Its threshold may send that Damage into adjacent lands, while the original target remains the land whose qualifying destruction triggers it.
changes.new: Its threshold may send that Damage into adjacent lands, while the original target remains the land whose qualifying destruction triggers it. The triggered effect still belongs to the Spirit that used Vengeance: if Bringer used it, its later Damage follows To Dream a Thousand Deaths even when another Spirit's action caused the triggering destruction.

changes.old: leaving the remaining Defend in the target; a later Power moving those Dahan does not carry that Defend.
changes.new: leaving the remaining Defend in the target. Only this Power's Defend 2 per pushed Dahan travels; separate Defend from another effect, such as Words of Warning, stays in its original land. A later Power moving those Dahan does not carry that Defend.

changes.old: **Choke the Land with Green** is optional (some printings omit “may”).
changes.new: **Choke the Land with Green** is optional (some printings omit “may”). Each use skips just that Ravage or Build action and costs one of Green's Presence in its Sacred Site there. A later Build needs a fresh decision and another disk: starting with three, Green may skip the Ravage, retain a two-disk Sacred Site, then skip the Build and end with one disk.
